Resolves #21684

A timeline whose region also scrolls other columns before it now measures from its own left edge. `Neo.timeline.Column` and `Neo.timeline.TimeAxisHeader` get an `axisLeft` getter, the timeline's x in the center body's `columnPositions`, and subtract it when they window bars and ticks. `Neo.gantt.DependencyLayer` gets an `axisLeft_` config: the layer is drawn from it and windows from `max(0, scrollLeft - axisLeft)`, the position its scroll guard reads. `Neo.gantt.Container` keeps it current when a column move rebuilds the positions, and while a column before the timeline is being resized: `Neo.grid.Body#updateCellPositions` moves the positions in place and now fires `cellPositionsChange`. `scrollLeft` keeps its documented meaning (center-content pixels) on all three classes, and with nothing before the timeline `axisLeft` is 0, so every existing layout computes what it did.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on `gantt/basic`, red on `dev`, green at head) → L3 required (every AC is a browser observation). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 links on bars, at scroll 0 and scrolled past the column | CI: `LeadingColumnsNL.spec.mjs`, "links stay on their bars with a column scrolling before the timeline" (x within 2 px, y within 0.25 px), and "links stay on their bars while the column before the timeline is being resized" (pointer held, both links required by id) |
| AC-2 bar and tick at the timeline's left edge, column wider than `bufferPx` | CI: same spec, "the bar and the day under the timeline's left edge render when the column before it is wider than the buffer" (220 px column, `bufferPx` 40) |
| AC-3 lock policy, switch and switch back | CI: same spec, "a responsive lock policy keeps the links on their bars both ways" (900 → 1440) |
| AC-4 red on `dev`, green at head | Outside CI: Test Evidence below (the CI red-on-base job runs unit specs only) |
| AC-5 all-locked Gantts unchanged | CI: the `test/playwright/e2e/gantt/` specs, `ZoomNL.spec.mjs`'s link measure among them, and the timeline, gantt and scheduler unit specs |

## Deltas from ticket
- The bar and tick windows were not only theoretical. A probe on `dev`, scrolled to 683 px with the timeline's visible edge 463 px into the axis, read the column's window from 643 px: "Gather materials" (ends at 518 px) and the "Wed 11" tick were on screen but not rendered.
- No consumer worked around the offset, so there is no consumer code to delete.
- A first draft of the AC-2 test passed on `dev`: it asserted before the scroll reached the App Worker. It now waits for the column's `scrollLeft`.
- Review round 1: the live column resize is a second writer of the positions the ticket names, so `Neo.grid.Body` gains the `cellPositionsChange` event; and the layer's window now clamps as its scroll guard does, which `Column` and `TimeAxisHeader` already did.

At head `2c2fad1cf8`: `LeadingColumnsNL.spec.mjs` 12 passed (`--repeat-each 3`), `DependencyLayer.spec.mjs` 4 passed.
